title: MailBackend::supports_type takes O: JmapObject as type param — caller must turbofish at every site
description: backend.rs:387 — fn supports_type<O: JmapObject>(&self) -> bool requires callers to write backend.supports_type::<SearchSnippet>() (turbofish). An alternative is to accept a &str type name: fn supports_type(&self, type_name: &str) -> bool, avoiding the generic monomorphization cost and making it callable through a vtable (dyn MailBackend could work). Current design is fine for static dispatch but cannot be used when the backend is a trait object. Flag as reviewed — OK for the current non-object-safe design.
